page: Google Cloud Platform n4d-standard-32 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the n4d server family. It features 32 dedicated virtual central processing units and 128.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This server type does not include bundled local storage or integrated graphics processing units. All storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage options. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the n4d-standard-32 is designed for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for applications requiring balanced compute and memory resources, such as medium-scale web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, and enterprise development environments. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource sharing tradeoffs.
